title: An invitation on hover
description: A tiny dot fills the button as a second label and arrow arrive.
useCase: Give a prominent occasional action an expressive pointer response.
reducedMotion: The surface changes color immediately; labels do not slide.
limitations: Hover enhancement applies only to fine pointers. Keyboard and touch preserve a usable standard button. The action toggles local state.
look: Warm sand-beige page with a single pale cream pill button outlined in tan, with a small brown dot beside a brown sans label.
motion: Hovering scales the dot 80× to flood the pill (300 ms expo ease-out); the label slides right and fades while a cream label and arrow arrive from the right.
adapt: All motion is CSS on hover: `.mg-hoverbutton-dot` scales to `scale(80)`, `.mg-hoverbutton-firsttext` translates and fades, `.mg-hoverbutton-second` slides in; tune the `cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1)` timings. Replace the label text and colours; keep the reduced-motion and focus-visible fallbacks.
